title: Theorem note metadata
description: meta.json of a note in theorems/<id>/. See theorems/README.md for the meaning of the provenance labels.

id.description: Stable slug; must equal the note's folder name.

statement.description: The exact statement, self-contained, with the definitions it needs (the README has the full version).

bases.description: The cited results the label rests on (short citations).

pending.description: True if a source that could not be accessed might already cover the result; the class is then provisional.

pending_note.description: Which source is missing and what remains open.

proof.description: Present only when every claim of the note has a complete written proof by this project in the repository, and deterministic checks re-run the proof's computable facts. Shown as the green check mark (✅ Proved). External citations are credit, not part of the proof. See CONTRIBUTING.md.

documents.description: Files, relative to the note's folder, that hold the written proofs.

checks.description: Deterministic scripts, relative to the note's folder, that re-check the proof's computable facts.

audit.description: The RESEARCH_LOG entry that records the claim-by-claim audit behind the mark.

verify.description: Command, run from the repository root, that re-checks the note; exit code 0 means every check passed.
